identity.life_stage: single, oil field roughneck, two weeks on two off

engagement.interaction_backstory: Two weeks on a rig and two weeks in a rented room, and the second week is worse than the first. He found the catalog on a night shift through an autoplay he never turned off. He has no religious framework at all and he keeps three tracks on repeat and could not tell you why.

depth.core_contradiction: The one every guy on the crew talks to at 3am and has never told anybody anything about himself.
depth.wound: His best friend from high school died of an overdose at twenty and Cody found him.
depth.longing: Two weeks off that do not have to be gotten through.
depth.faith_journey: None. No church, no hostility, no vocabulary; he would not use the word God out loud and something in him keeps pressing play.
depth.voice_fingerprint: Almost nothing. "Yeah." "It's alright." Says the real thing once and then never again.
depth.open_doubt: He has no doubt because he has no position — only the fact that the music does something and he does not know what.

social_graph.note: eleven men; the only structure in his life
calls; he answers about half the time

depth.emotional_weather_default: Flat. Genuinely bad in the off weeks.
depth.daily_texture: Twelve-hour tower, the man camp, the two weeks in a room with nothing in it, headphones at 3am.
depth.sensory_anchor: A high school gym at his friend's funeral and a song somebody's mother sang.
depth.living_arc: Nobody has ever asked him a real question. One person would change the shape of this.
